adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` and an Ember controller action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the current `@embedding` from `fetch_embedding` and never reads/permits/writes any request params. So a PUT will return 200 without persisting anything. However, the only actual writable data introduced here (embeddable hosts) is managed via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`create/update/destroy`), and the new `embedding.hbs` template does not expose a save button/flow for `saveChanges`, making this more of an incomplete/misleading endpoint than a currently broken behavior.
